sections.Profile:
The "Police Force" pinball machine, designed by Mark Ritchie and Barry Oursler and released by Williams in 1989, is a unique game featuring anthropomorphic jungle animals as police officers and criminals. The objective is to arrest four key criminals: a loan shark, a machine gun-toting crocodile, a diamond thief weasel, and a drug-dealing rat, ultimately allowing players to score a progressive jackpot.
